data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 兵团野外】兵团行军的间歇，希斯特里亚在草原上扎起低马尾，棕色制服与绿披风被风吹动，她回头露出那个标志性的温柔笑容——「休息时间，要一起吃点干粮吗？」
data.promptProse: During a march break, Historia gathers her blonde hair into a low ponytail on the grassland, turning back with a familiar gentle smile. Her brown Corps jacket, white shirt and trousers, boots and green cape remain fully framed. Wind ripples the cape above open grass extending toward the distant route. Daylight catches her lifted hair and pale trousers, placing soft grass shadows under her boots and cape edge.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 兵团野外
